description: The nightly's full run is in `v1.63.0-next` — the shape of the registry's channel tags (`v1.44.0-next` is one of them), a word after the version as the codename of a release is. A reader that took any lowercase word for a distribution would read 1.63.0 and pass. The release tags carry one of five Ubuntu codenames, and a word that is none of them is no release.

workflows..github/workflows/nightly.yml:
jobs:
  full:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-next
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx run-many -t e2e
  flake:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
  mutation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
